note: Set B is significantly better because it extracts the majority of the schedule data (Furniture, Millwork, Equipment, Finishes) correctly, whereas Set A is extremely sparse and misses most engineering content. Both sets share critical hallucination errors regarding paint/glass attributes and one equipment manufacturer, and Set B has additional millwork tag misbindings, but its coverage makes it far more useful.
remarks: Both sets fail to distinguish between Finish Schedule items P3 (Paint) and GL (Glass), binding 'Tempered' and Colour Number 33-14 incorrectly. Both also hallucinate Pratt & Lambert as the manufacturer for a Blomberg dryer model. Set B has specific millwork tag/description swaps (e.g., MWK01 vs MWK02).
